subject.title: Silent empty tool results in long-running Sonnet 5 sessions after a large tool result

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 be treated as the canonical fix path for this issue now that additional non-Sonnet provider evidence points at shared prompt projection, or should this issue require separate installed-session payload proof first?
rationale: The source and related reports strongly overlap with the candidate PR, but the exact reporter scenario has not been live-proven against that PR and the candidate branch is currently conflicting.

options.title: Canonicalize On The Prompt-Projection PR
options.body: Treat the open PR or an equivalent refreshed replacement as the canonical fix path, then close this issue only after merged main or release proof plus redacted provider-payload validation.

options.title: Require Separate Payload Proof
options.body: Keep this issue as a distinct tracker until a failing and after-fix Anthropic/Google provider payload comparison proves the candidate fix covers the reported large-result trigger.

options.title: Split A Broader Follow-Up
options.body: Use the candidate PR for non-trailing fresh-result preservation and keep a separate follow-up for remaining cache/provider-session cases if proof shows a second mechanism.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize On The Prompt-Projection PR
recommendation.body: Treat the open PR or an equivalent refreshed replacement as the canonical fix path, then close this issue only after merged main or release proof plus redacted provider-payload validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent fresh tool-result protection in the same helper and are the strongest history signal for the recovery-ordering tradeoff.
